The current core build still has DiagnosticReport and Observation as active resources, but workflow-relatedArtifact is found in current core source only as an OID. The authoritative StructureDefinition now lives in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/multiple/StructureDefinition-workflow-relatedArtifact.xml, which lists DiagnosticReport and Observation contexts and preserves the supportingInfo contrast. FHIR-39113 later expanded the same extension to Observation.component and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source edit is appropriate because the extension definition is outside this checkout and already satisfies the FHIR-15824 request in the Extension Pack.
